domain_label: Knowledge Discovery: Search Systems plus Research Methodology
purpose: integrated machine-facing ontology to locate authoritative sources via information retrieval and validate them via research methodology and epistemology, producing graded, cited, uncertainty-aware knowledge claims
assumptions: two domains are modeled as one integrated parent domain knowledge_discovery_search_plus_methodology
no observed dataset or benchmark evidence is supplied; all values are heuristic priors
dense density mode is selected for two-domain coverage
IR-based source location feeds methodological validity assessment as the central interface
balanced coverage of information retrieval and research methodology is required
exclusions: non-academic general web search ranking outside scholarly scope
production search infrastructure operations and SRE concerns
domain-specific subject matter beyond knowledge discovery and validation
